title: Ads creative territory table (BC-28299)
description: The territory table the ads creative pipeline reads. The real file lives in the private runner config; its path is the runner config key `territories_path`. This repo is public, so it holds only this schema and territories.example.json, whose numbers are fictional 555-010-xxxx numbers. scripts/ads_agent/creative.py load_territories enforces the same shape.

site.description: Key for one Brite site. Tracking numbers are per site. Unique in the file.

territory.description: Canonical territory name (brite-data-platform seeds/ref_territories.csv). Written to the creative-inputs row.

cities.description: City names an ad headline may name for this site. The first is the default.

phones.description: The site's call-tracking number on each ad platform.

logo.description: The logo file the template places, and the id the brand check matches.

phone.description: A US number written as it appears in the ad: (NNN) NNN-NNNN.
